inputSchemaCoverage: Command envelopes and documented nested fields; adapter, revision, applicability and physical validation remain authoritative.

operations.description: Read retained visual-export job state and its read-only executionSettled boolean.
limitations: Argument envelope only; runtime validation remains authoritative.

executionSettled remains false until renderer and artifact processing have settled and shared renderer exclusion is released. Cancellation changes state immediately; cancelled does not imply cleanup has finished. The same boolean is returned by startExport/startCompareExport/cancelExport summaries. This describes visual-export execution only, not analysis job execution. Released jobs remain unknown.
